w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Redactor: Go quiet — starve the redaction. It redacts the loudest thing first, and the handles point a full round before the redaction lands. Go quiet for two turns and its attacks come thin; a third quiet turn starves it out of the fight. (Striking feeds it — every wound gets un-written.) (Aki lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Gavel is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A lean scout waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/12/6), with 9 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 37 → 24 · capped · Craft 8 · Talk 15 · Explore 41 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Caleb Jones ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
